items.physical_semantics: Four physical wheel joints receive the effort-plant command; braking is an explicit plant state rather than a controller-only label.
items.requirement: A ROS velocity command reaches all four wheel effort joints and zero/E-stop has a physical stop path.

items.physical_semantics: Six arm position interfaces plus one gripper actuator drive named URDF joints; the passive finger linkage has a dedicated Gazebo effort system.
items.requirement: Six commanded UR5e joints and one physical Robotiq actuator are controller-backed and launched with the cube scenario.

items.physical_semantics: The cube carries density-derived inertial mass and collision geometry; monitor evidence is tied to deposit and bin-floor contacts, not a symbolic counter.
items.requirement: A material-specific 30 mm rigid cube launch and finger/deposition/floor contact bridges reach the physical dry-bin monitor.

items.physical_semantics: Physical-resident dry payloads remain separate rigid bodies and the aggregate inertia path rejects a simultaneous dry-mass input.
items.requirement: A newly contained physical cube must remain an independent rigid body, transfer its load through the rear-bin contact path, and never also enter the aggregate dry inertia ledger.

items.physical_semantics: Ground-dirt state is derived from the lowered, rotating side brushes and central roller rather than a controller command alone.
items.requirement: A lowered rotating brush sweeps a source-owned dirt grid and publishes a measurable coverage state through its dedicated runtime validator.

items.requirement: Side brushes, central roller, lift, compliant squeegee and pump joint states gate recoverable-water transfer into the wastewater tank mass ledger.
